children: UK security systems developer's H1 2026 revenue declined slightly yr/yr to £7.7 mln
Adjusted EBITDA for H1 2026 rose over 50% yr/yr, driven by higher margin business
Company returned to operating profit and reduced net debt during the period
Company expects continued cash generation in H2 and further reduction in net debt by year end
Petards expects to deliver significant improvement in results over those achieved in 2025
Company says improved order intake in Rail and Defence driving operational efficiencies and margin gains
HIGHER MARGIN BUSINESS - Co said improved profitability was driven by successful delivery of higher margin business, leading to increased gross profit margin
RAIL AND DEFENCE GROWTH - Strong contributions from Rail and Defence segments, with Rail benefiting from improved trading conditions and Defence from commencement of major engineering order
RECURRING REVENUES - Recurring revenues remained stable and cash generative across group operations
